stem: Which statement accurately compares eukaryotic cells and prokaryotic cells?

options.label: A
options.text: Eukaryotic cells are more complex than prokaryotic cells.

options.label: B
options.text: Eukaryotic cells replicate faster than prokaryotic cells.

options.label: C
options.text: Only prokaryotic cells have membrane-bound organelles.

options.label: D
options.text: Only prokaryotic cells lack outer membranes and cell walls.
